title: Olivia and the Invisible Ocean
subtitle: We live at the bottom of a sea of air
author: Olivia's Shelf
blurb: Olivia waves a paper fan and learns that air is real, has weight, and hugs everything — even a cup stuck to the table.

magic.launch: The little rocket pushed the air, and the air pushed back.
magic.drop: Everything falls. That pull has a name: gravity.

openai.instructions: Warm, clear storyteller reading a science picture book to a child. Curious, never lecturing. Pause at full stops.

pages.heading: Something pushed
pages.text: {Olivia} waved a paper {fan}. A scrap of paper jumped. "{Elon:elon/look}," she said. "Something invisible pushed it."

pages.heading: A sea of air
pages.text: "{Air} is real. It has weight," said {Elon:elon/teach}. "We live at the bottom of an invisible {ocean}."

pages.heading: Air pushes back
pages.text: Olivia squeezed a bottle. The air inside pushed {back}. "That squeeze is {pressure}," said Elon.

pages.heading: Warm air rises
pages.text: "Warm air is lighter, so it {rises}," said {Elon:elon/teach}. "A breeze is air sliding from here to there."

pages.heading: Thinner up high
pages.text: They looked at a {mountain:stars/glow}. "High up, the ocean of air is {thinner}," said Elon. "Your ears can feel the change."

pages.heading: Keep asking why
pages.text: "Why does a sucked cup stick?" asked {Olivia:olivia/ask}. "Outside air is hugging it down," said {Elon:elon/teach}. "Ask why again tomorrow."

end.heading: The End
end.text: Air is an invisible ocean. It has weight. It hugs everything.
end.prompt: What would you fan, squeeze, or stick tomorrow?

credits: Painted for Olivia's Shelf. Elon is a picture-book inventor who teaches physics; this is not a biography.

questions.wrong: Elon said we live at the bottom of an invisible ocean.

questions.right: That's right. Squeezed air pushes back.
questions.wrong: Pressure is the squeeze of air.
